summary:
At Melrose Arch your iPhone is your wallet, room key, ride-hailing app and diary. Whether you live there, work in the offices or are staying in one of the hotels, a broken iPhone stops everything.

Melrose Arch is one of the shortest trips in our service area. Our workshop at Silvercrest Shopping Centre in Silvamonte is about 6 km away, around 8 to 12 minutes' drive.

Don't replace your iPhone just yet. We repair screens, batteries and back glass, and we handle board-level faults too. Every repair starts with a free diagnostic and carries a 6-month warranty. Courier collection starts from R300.
